recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中有一大團緊密聚集、大小一致的小圓形腫瘤細胞，並嵌在淡紫色纖維狀的基質（neuropil）中，與周圍血液及散在造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large cohesive clump of small, uniform round tumor cells at low power
Tumor cells embedded in pale lilac, fibrillary background material consistent with neuropil
Cells have high N:C ratio and dark round nuclei; individual detail limited at this magnification
Surrounding blood-rich field with scattered dispersed hematopoietic cells
Note: image is a Wright-Giemsa aspirate smear rather than a trephine section
describe_en: Low-power view of a Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive aggregate of small, uniform round tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios embedded in pale lilac fibrillary material consistent with neuropil. Surrounding areas contain blood and scattered hematopoietic cells. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. The presence of clumped small round cells with neuropil is consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed rather than clumped, lack neuropil, and are CD45/TdT positive, whereas neuroblastoma is CD45 negative and PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Rhabdomyosarcoma forms clusters with vacuolated cytoplasm but no neuropil, and expresses desmin and myogenin.
Ewing sarcoma shows PAS-positive vacuolated cells without neuropil, with CD99/NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement.
Marrow particles contain mixed hematopoietic lineages, fat and megakaryocytes rather than a monotonous small round cell population.
